projectDescription: ParleHub is a shared AI workspace for professional services firms that allocates AI spend by client project code, with budget controls, team collaboration, and enterprise-grade governance.
keyFeatures: Per-project AI budget enforcement with pre-flight spend blocking
Client expense codes on every project, exportable to billing systems
Shared project threads with real-time presence and semantic search
Native file tools: search, read, query spreadsheets, convert documents
Enterprise SSO via Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace
Files stored in your own SharePoint or Google Drive tenant
Multi-provider support: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI
Role-based access: org admin, project admin, member
Usage analytics broken down by project, person, provider, or model
publicApiSurface: Model provider connection (BYOK: bring your own API key)
Role assignment (org admin, project admin, member)
